text:
Your average speed for the whole round trip is **96 km/h**.

- Distance: 160 km + 160 km = 320 km
- Time going: 160 ÷ 80 = 2 hours
- Time returning: 160 ÷ 120 = 4/3 hours (about 1 h 20 min)
- Total time: 2 + 4/3 = 10/3 hours

Average speed = 320 ÷ (10/3) = 96 km/h

This is the harmonic mean of 80 and 120, not the simple average of 100 km/h, because you spend more time on the slower leg.
